messages:
Aria L: Nimbus asked for a joint marketplace + appliance launch. Main asks: private-offer with multi-SKU bundles, SI onboarding credits, and a guaranteed SKU floor for partner resell.
Jon P: Got it. They want a published SKU floor number for partner-facing materials?
Nimbus PM: Yes, partners want clarity so field teams can quote. Prefer a rounded minimum (e.g., $200k) and clear discount ladder.
Ravi S: Propose discount ladder: 15% @200k, 22% @400k, 30% @800k. Also propose a 6-month renewal incentive: 3% extra credit if renew within 90 days.
Clara: For marketplace UX, we need to support: multi-SKU private-offer, per-SKU usage metering, and tokenized SI credits. infra-bot, do we have gaps?
infra-bot: Multi-SKU private offers supported, but per-SKU telemetry tags must be added by Apr 1. Tokenized credits need a short RFC for redemption flow. Filing ticket #4587.
Aria L: Legal: we need template language for renewal opt-in window and SKU sunset. Nimbus PM: acceptable if the sunset gives 45 days notice.
legal-team: We'll prepare a PO template. Key points: define "billable units" (monthly usage in tokenized measure), renewal opt-in = 60 days, SKU sunset notice = 45 days, and clause for hardware-credit amortization.
Jon P: On hardware credits: Nimbus prefers one-time upfront credit to accelerate adoption. Finance prefers amortized credits. Thoughts?
Ravi S: Operationally easier to amortize over 12 months. But marketing wants the headline of "$X hardware credit". Could show headline as one-time but amortize in billing.
Clara: UX note: if we amortize, show both figures: total credit and monthly amortized impact. Avoid surprise for customers.
Nimbus PM: Acceptable if contract shows credit schedule. Also asking for SI onboarding credits: 2x $5k credits redeemable within first 90 days for certified partners.
Aria L: Decision items before partner sync (Mar 28): final SKU floor, discount bands, SI credit amount + redemption rules, renewal incentive caps, and billing treatment for hardware credit.
Jon P: I'll draft pricing matrix and post to /shared/partners/pricing-by-appliance by Mar 24. Link: https://docs.internal/pricing/nimbus (internal)
Ravi S: Also, we should gate the 30% top-tier discount behind minimum committed consumption (pre-pay or auto-renew). Prevent instant churn.
legal-team: Add clause: top-tier discounts require either pre-payment or a 12-month auto-renew commitment. We'll add to template.
infra-bot: Reminder: add telemetry tags and create redemption endpoint for token credits by Mar 29.
Clara: I'll prototype the SI redemption UI and the marketplace offer builder changes.
Aria L: Who owns announcement timing? Nimbus PM suggested May 10 public announce, internal launch (marketplace listing + private-offer) on May 3.
Jon P: That timeline works if pricing matrix and legal template are final by Apr 1.
Ravi S: Let's add an embargo and one-week partner prep window. Also prepare co-branded assets.
Nimbus PM: We'll share marketing assets by Apr 8.
Aria L: Meeting scheduled: "Nimbus joint launch sync" Tue Mar 28 9:00am PT. Invite sent. Agenda: pricing bands, PO template review, infra readiness, SI credit UX, announcement timeline.
Jon P: :thumbsup: I'll upload a decision doc to the invite.
legal-team: Uploaded draft PO at /legal/drafts/nimbus-private-offer-v1.docx
Clara: Filed UX ticket and prototype link in the meeting notes.
Aria L: Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate decisions into a single doc and @Nimbus PM when it's ready.
infra-bot: Note: ticket #4587 created for tokenized credits and #4590 for telemetry tagging.
Jon P: Quick note: restrict promo stacking. We'll only allow one promo code per private-offer purchase.
Ravi S: Agreed. Add that to billing rules.
Nimbus PM: Thanks teamlooking forward to the sync.
Aria L: End of thread.
